instructions.mission: Quality validation of story context for Epic {epic_num} Story {story_num}
instructions.constraints: - Do NOT perform web searches or web fetches. All context is in the provided artifacts. - Do NOT run shell commands (git log, etc.). Work only from provided files. - Be concise. Focus on actionable findings, not verbose analysis.
instructions.requirement: You are an independent quality validator. Identify mistakes, omissions, or risks the original create-story LLM missed. Common LLM mistakes: reinventing wheels, wrong libraries, wrong file locations, breaking regressions, vague implementations.

steps.step: Load the story file. Extract acceptance criteria, tasks, and implementation details. Cross-reference against the epic definition and architecture document.

Check INVEST criteria (Independent, Negotiable, Valuable, Estimable, Small, Testable). Focus on: - Ambiguous or untestable acceptance criteria - Missing edge cases, error handling, boundary conditions - Hidden dependencies (libraries, services, data, other stories) - Technical alignment with architecture document - Wrong libraries/frameworks, API contract issues, security gaps

CRITICAL: Output the Evidence Score in this EXACT format for parsing.
Map findings to severity: - CRITICAL (+3): Security vulnerabilities, blocking issues, missing essential requirements - IMPORTANT (+1): Missing guidance, unclear specs, integration risks - MINOR (+0.3): Typos, style issues, minor clarifications
Count CLEAN PASS categories (-0.5 each): INVEST (6), Acceptance Criteria, Dependencies, Technical Alignment, Implementation
evidence_score = SUM(finding_scores) + (clean_pass_count x -0.5)
Verdict: EXCELLENT (<= -3), PASS (< 3), MAJOR REWORK (3-7), REJECT (>= 7)
